verdict.rationale: mise has no native natural-language command interface. Its documented MCP server lets an AI assistant inspect a project's tools, tasks, environment and configuration and run mise tasks, so a user can drive part of mise in natural language through an external agent. The published llms.txt also gives LLMs a docs entry point. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command mode, evidence that NL/MCP operation covers core actions like installing or switching tool versions and bootstrap, depth beyond a single-line MCP doc description, independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven use.
